correctness.rationale: The three modular reductions, gcd normalization, parity step, converse and uniqueness were rederived independently; a bounded exact enumeration of 186647 prime arithmetic progressions and 226000 residue cases found zero mismatches.

originality.rationale: Known sources include the Lucas–Carmichael definition/infinitude, the A290810 negative-Chernick subfamily, and general three-prime analyses, but the inspected sources and synonymous searches did not reveal the full arithmetic-progression iff parametrization. Originality is to the best of our knowledge, with named older-source residual risks.

value.rationale: The result turns an isolated known construction into a complete structural classification, reduces each shape to one explicit congruence ray, and shows those rays are admissible for the prime-tuples conjecture.
